Description: Natural death of susceptibles at rate n (removed from susceptible pool)
Renewal of susceptibles through birth, immigration, and/or loss of acquired immunity at rate n*H (total inflow to susceptible compartment)
Net growth/loss of V. cholerae in the aquatic environment at rate (nb - mb), where nb is the growth rate and mb is the loss rate

Name: n
Description: Human birth and death rate (susceptible renewal rate)

Name: a
Description: Rate of exposure to contaminated water (contact rate)

Name: K
Description: Concentration of V. cholerae in water that yields 50% chance of catching cholera (half-saturation constant)

Name: r
Description: Rate at which people recover from cholera

Name: nb
Description: Growth rate of V. cholerae in the aquatic environment

Name: mb
Description: Loss rate of V. cholerae in the aquatic environment

Name: nb-mb
Description: Net growth rate of V. cholerae in the aquatic environment (negative indicates net loss)

Name: e
Description: Contribution of each infected person to the population of V. cholerae in the aquatic environment
